plugins.photosPermission: DAUST Messenger opens your photo library when you tap the attach button so you can choose a picture to send in a conversation.
plugins.cameraPermission: DAUST Messenger uses your camera when you tap the camera button so you can take a photo and send it in a conversation.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: DAUST Messenger reads your current position when you tap the location button so you can share where you are in a conversation.

plugins.cameraPermission: DAUST Messenger uses your camera on the Scan screen to scan a classmate's DAUST Messenger QR code and add them as a contact.
